profile.headline: Staff software engineer at Qualcomm
profile.summary: Long time software engineer with a passion for learning

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Radio Frequency (RF) · Mobile Devices · Modems · C (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed on modems in L2 / L3 layers for LTE
Performed root cause analysis on issues from hardware to BSP and other device drivers up to network messaging. 

Developed and maintained 80 tests that covered most project requirements over multiple projects and dozens of platforms. 
Designed and established paradigms for test environment setup, development environments and test automation. 

Developed tooling to automatically generate test plans from requirement documents and test case linkages for any number of projects and platforms. 

Developed and maintained android testing software. 

Developed and maintained a number of test tools for the Nomad satellite internet project:
- Project dashboard tool to track the status of over 60 racks, keeping track of system health, and helping both management and engineers be more aware and able to fix potential and current issues. Using react and flask combo. 
- Antenna and GPS emulators for pieces of the system that were developed by partners and were not complete yet. 
- Log parsing utilities to find and track errors in millions of lines of logs. Including a web interface.
